Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our SIG review we need a short packet focused on business continuity and key management controls. Attached is the SIG export with a highlighted BCP/DR section — the reviewers asked for specific evidence for RTO/RPO claims and the keystore rotation process.

Could you provide the following by EOD Friday, Nov 12?
- A short signed statement that confirms the published RTO/RPO for the Redwood Hosted API and Dedicated clusters (latest committed SLOs).
- Copies or excerpts of the runbook sections showing failover activation steps and estimated warm-start times (preferably with timestamps from the last 3 exercises).
- Keystore rotation procedure: whether rotation is automated (KMS/HSM) or manual, list of approved key-holders (roles, not personal emails), and rotation cadence.
- Any chain-of-custody or retention logs for KV cache snapshots / WAL archives showing the last successful restore test.

We attached the SIG_questionnaire_2027-11-09.pdf with inline comments. If it helps, can we schedule a 30-minute call to run through the asks and confirm artifacts? Available windows: Thu 11/11 09:00-11:00 PT or Fri 11/12 08:00-12:00 PT.

Thanks,

Hi all — pulling together the artifacts. Status and notes below.

1) Runbook excerpts and exercise timestamps
- Attached: runbook-excerpt.txt (sections: failover-activation, verification-checks, post-restore smoke tests).
- Attached: failover-exercises-2027-08_to_2027-10.csv (CSV snippet with timestamps). Last three exercises: 2027-08-21 (duration 18m), 2027-09-15 (duration 22m), 2027-10-27 (duration 20m). These are warm-start exercises against Dedicated clusters in us-west-2.

2) RTO/RPO statement
- Committed targets vary by offering. Short summary included below and full signed statement will be attached to the packet Jasmine assembles.
  - Hosted API: RTO target (regional outage) = 2 hours; RPO = 15 minutes for metadata and 5 minutes for request-level KV cache recovery (best-effort cache warm-up).
  - Dedicated (reserved pools): RTO target = 60 minutes; RPO = 5 minutes for persistence-backed state.
  - Private (customer-managed): RTO/RPO depend on on-prem configuration; we provide guidance and test templates.

3) Keystore rotation and key-holders
- Keystore rotation: automated via customer-managed KMS for Private; automated rotation supported for Dedicated and Hosted (HSM-backed key material when customers opt-in to Redwood-managed HSM). Rotation cadence: default 90 days for customer-managed keys, 180 days for Redwood-managed HSM keys.
- Approved key-holder roles (not personal emails): Site Reliability Engineer, Security Ops Lead, Backup Owner. We can provide a role-to-duty matrix; we do not publish direct personal contact list in SIG artifacts.

4) Chain-of-custody and WAL/KV snapshots
- We can provide retention manifests and a redacted sample of the restore log showing last successful test. Logs will be sanitized for customer PII.

Attachments in this message: runbook-excerpt.txt (text), failover-exercises-2027-08_to_2027-10.csv (CSV snippet). Also prepping the BCP_RPO_statement_2027-11-12.pdf for Jasmine to sign.

Let me know if you want the raw telemetry traces; we can provide them under an NDA.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Site Reliability
Redwood Inference
